verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's search/offers API and CLI let engineers query live marketplace inventory (GPU type, count, verified status, price) before renting, and this was independently confirmed via a keyless live probe against both the CLI and the public REST bundles endpoint returning real-time offers with reliability data. This directly satisfies seeing availability before provisioning rather than hitting a stockout on create.  missing for 10: explicit region/geolocation filter documentation and evidence of real-time refresh/alerting for capacity changes.
